sloka: सुग्रीवे स शरान् घोरान् विससर्ज चमूमुखे।स्थापयामास चोद्विग्नान् राक्षसान् सम्प्रहर्षयन् ।। ६.९७.१६ ।।
transliteration: sugrīve sa śarān ghorān visasarja camūmukhe।sthāpayāmāsa codvignān rākṣasān sampraharṣayan ।। 6.97.16 ।।

translations.english: Releasing arrows at the army of Vanaras and Sugriva, he (Virupaksha) pierced arrows and relieved the Rakshasas of fear and made them happy.
